headline: US IP Does Not Expect Substantial Improvement in Security Before 2030
summary: American companies in Mexico continue to spend heavily on protection against crime, which equates to a tax, and do not expect security to improve substantially before 2030.
why: Security spending raises operating costs for foreign firms, which affects investment decisions in Mexico.
original_headline: IP de EU no espera mejora sustancial en seguridad antes del 2030
